 Follow Arnold Schwarzenegger reveals he and ex-wife Maria Shriver still spend holidays together after divorce
 The exes separated in 2011 after 25 years of marriage and finalized their divorce in 2021.
 Kathleen Perricone Tue, November 17, 2026 at 3:50 AM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Arnold Schwarzenegger and Maria Shriver with their kids Christina, Patrick, and Katherine in 2017
Credit: Emma McIntyre/Getty Images Key Points
 Arnold Schwarzenegger reveals he and ex-wife Maria Shriver still spend holidays together.
 "Even though we're divorced, the kids, they like to see you always together," says the actor.
 Schwarzenegger and Shriver separated in 2011 after 25 years of marriage and finalized their divorce in 2021.
 For better or for worse, Arnold Schwarzenegger and Maria Shriver still spend time together as a family.
 More than a decade after the couple of 25 years separated, the exes consistently celebrate the holidays and special occasions with each other and their four adult children.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "Even though we're divorced, the kids, they like to see you always together," the Terminator actor told PEOPLE . "The family is always together."
 This holiday season will be no different as their family has extended to in-laws and grandchildren: eldest daughter Katherine shares three children with husband Chris Pratt and son Patrick married model Abby Champion last year.
 Arnold Schwarzenegger and Maria Shriver at the Cannes Film Festival in 2003 
 Credit: Pascal Le Segretain/Getty 
 On Dec. 25, "we go over to Maria's house and then we celebrate with her, and she has a huge Christmas tree," said Schwarzenegger, who has been in a relationship with physical therapist Heather Milligan since 2013.
 "The kids love that," he added. "So we do that, we continue with that tradition."
 Advertisement Advertisement The exes recently reunited for the actor's 79th birthday. Katherine shared a photo on Instagram showing the patriarch with a slice of cake and sitting next to Shriver and three of their four children.
 The TV journalist told Entertainment Weekly 's sister site PEOPLE in 2025 that she and Schwarzenegger are "in a good place" and always communicate about their family. "We laugh a lot about our kids, our grandkids, ourselves, and we are proud of the fact that we are still in conversation... I'm really happy with my life and my work with my children."
 The former couple split in 2011, a week before it was publicly revealed that Schwarzenegger had fathered a son with the family's housekeeper, Patty Baena.
 "It's not like we had a feud. We didn't have a fight. It's just my f--- up, right?" Schwarzenegger said of Shriver in a 2023 interview with PEOPLE . "She said, 'Okay, this is what it is,' and then she decided to make a split, so it was her decision. But the fact is, we always made it very clear that the kids should not suffer because of that."
 Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter . 
 The actor's youngest, Joseph Baena, has followed in his father's footsteps, recently becoming a professional bodybuilder .
 Advertisement Advertisement "He's the best training partner," the 29-year-old told GQ in April. "He pushes me. He makes sure that I don't slack off in the gym. When the carbs are low and the calories are low and I start getting tired, he pumps me up."
